Description

Caliptra/vendor-specific control bits outside the OCP Recovery command set. Firmware (EXT/AXI) writable only.

Contents

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name
[31:1] RESERVED_31_1 r 0x0 Reserved
[0] OCP_PATH_DISABLE rw 0x0 OCP Recovery Path Disable

Field Descriptions

RESERVED_31_1 - Reserved

Reserved for future Caliptra-specific control bits.

OCP_PATH_DISABLE - OCP Recovery Path Disable

Emergency-fallback control bit. When set, forces the VHDL post-synchronizer OCP recovery arbiter (usb_ocp_recovery_post_sync_arb.m.vhdl, ocp_path_disable_i port) to never claim an OCP-class SETUP, so every EP0 transfer falls through to the legacy SIE / MCU EPCS path bit-identically to the un-arbitered IP. Firmware/EXT write-only (swwe gated by rb_is_ext in usb_ocp_recovery_top.sv), so a USB-host write is ignored. Reset default 0 (OCP recovery path active).
